title: Easy French
author: Easy French
description:
Easy French is a project to help you learn French in an authentic and fun way. We interview people in the streets of Paris and other places of the French speaking world. We also create "Super Easy" videos where members of the team speak in slower French, in order to help beginners and intermediate learners. All our videos have subtitles in French and English.

Easy French is part of the global project Easy Languages, though it has its own YouTube channel where 4 videos are published every month:
